name: Zawy
cooked: I was puzzling over why w has to increase a lot to lower T_{min} if T is starting out close to it. It turns out that if hashrate increases 5% in every period, it decreases T_{min} by 5%. So it’s wrong to think that Bitcoin’s “consistent” 5% per period hashrate increase would have bumped up against T_{min} if it was a lot larger. It just lowers T_{min} at about the same rate. And that’s how much T itself move for whatever timestamp scheme they use.
